First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @gravelfoco the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fort Collins Gravel People group ride

A Tuesday night gravel ride that calls itself intermediate-focused but beginner-friendly. Around 13–14 mph with a regroup or two. Rides usually end at someone's house or a brewery. Start point changes; check Instagram or Strava.
